# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 93 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 50 | Coptic

---

## Saying 93

Jesus said: "Do not give what is holy to dogs, lest they cast it on the dunghill. Do not cast pearls before swine, lest they grind it to mud."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "Dunghill" — the refuse heap; the sacred reduced to garbage
- "Cast... before swine" — follows the Matthean tradition ("cast before")
- "Grind it to mud" — the swine's action more violent; mud as degradation
